mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production, defined as 3 consecutive monthly declines, signals a weakening supply-side of the economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 3 consecutive monthly INDPRO declines occur but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will suppress economic activity and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises > 10% Y/Y but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4% and payroll employment growth accelerates by more than 200k jobs per month, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation and compress corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 200k/month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1% and the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3%, it signals that monetary policy is too accommodative given the inflation backdrop, which will drive market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL > 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth accelerating by more than 3% year-over-year, combined with a falling unemployment rate, signals a strong and self-reinforcing expansion that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth > 3% Y/Y and UNRATE falling but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.
